svg.title: Black Friday: p99 queue wait per 10 s bucket, FIFO and DRR
svg.desc: Two line charts side by side on one log-scale y axis. Each line is one shop's p99 queue wait for the jobs that arrived in each 10-second bucket. The shaded band is the spike, when shop-01.mockshop.test sends at the spike rate. The tables in report.md hold the same numbers.
svg.text: Black Friday: p99 queue wait per 10 s bucket of arrival
shop-01.mockshop.test sends 2000 jobs/s during the shaded spike; every other shop stays at 20 jobs/s. Log scale.
